content: Microsoft Entra authentication is now generally available for Azure HorizonDB, providing a more secure, identity-based approach to database authentication. You can use Microsoft Entra authentication to centrally manage identities and access instead of relying solely on locally managed database passwords, helping you reduce credential-management overhead and strengthen your security posture. Microsoft Entra authentication is the recommended authentication approach for HorizonDB. You can use Microsoft Entra authentication exclusively for stronger protection against password-based risks or enable it alongside HorizonDB password authentication when you still require local credentials. Learn more.
